name: project-maintainer
description: Keeps a project's memory in its .claude folder: decisions recorded as ADRs, technical debt tracked in a ledger, and a handoff that carries each session's state to the next one.

commitNudge.title: Remind Claude after a commit that looks like a decision
commitNudge.description: After a commit that changes dependencies, a database schema, CI or infrastructure, or whose message says workaround, temporary or revert, add one note that reminds Claude to record a decision or a debt. It uses no model call.
